title: Forward testing TV Strategies
author: sdomas
selftext: I have been building a lot of pine script strategies with AI tools and most of them look good on backtesting and fail in live markets. I just wanted to share I found this website very useful if anyone wants to forward test multiple strategies, just set and forget. It worked for me refining my strategy thought to share it. Check out   pnlytics.io

comments.author: Ok_Map5721
comments.body:
Forward testing is the right instinct, but there's a catch with doing it for many strategies at once. If you forward test 20 strategies and keep the 2 that did best, you've just moved the overfitting from the backtest to the forward test. Some of them will look good live by luck alone, especially over a few weeks.

What helps: decide in advance which strategies you're testing and what result counts as a pass, then judge each one against that, not against the others. And give it enough trades. A few dozen trades forward can't tell a 55% strategy from a coin flip.
